title: Darrybook - Portfolio of Jean Paulette | Privacy policy

sections.title: Privacy Policy
sections.content:
This website is a **personal portfolio** hosted on [Vercel](https://vercel.com).

## Data Collected
When you use the contact form, I collect the information you submit (name, email, and message). This data is used only to respond to your request. Submitting the form is treated as consent to this processing.

## Storage & Processing
Depending on the form configuration, submissions are delivered by email and may also be stored in Airtable for follow-up. Data is kept only as long as needed to handle your request and can be deleted upon request.

## Cookies
This site does not use advertising or analytics cookies. Essential cookies may be set by the hosting provider for security and performance.

## Hosting
Hosting is provided by *Vercel Inc.* (United States). Server logs (anonymous) may contain your IP address for security and maintenance.

## Your Rights
Under the **General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR)**, you can request access, correction, or deletion of your data by contacting me via the [contact form](/en/contact).
sections.note: This policy reflects current form handling and will be updated if tools or storage change.
